detected.heading: Manage this Docker host?
detected.body: Coaming found Docker on {{name}} and can manage it through the socket.

localHost.notice: Managing a host through the Docker socket gives Coaming, and any admin who signs in here, root-equivalent control of that host.

unreachable.heading: Docker isn't answering
unreachable.body: Coaming found a Docker socket at {{path}}, but Docker didn't answer. Check that Docker is running and that Coaming is allowed to open the socket, then check again.
